---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped improvement to the local research workspace
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What research, paper-trading, accessibility, or developer problem should this
change solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the workflow and its failure states. Include Web/iOS behavior if the
feature changes a shared contract.

## Data and cost

- Which data source or local record is required?
- Does this add provider requests, storage, licensing, or recurring cost?
- What happens when the data is stale, missing, or malformed?

## Security and privacy

- Does this change authentication, sessions, exports, retention, networking, or
  secret storage?
- Could it expose user data or credentials?

## Financial safety

- Does it affect a score, scenario level, options/day-trade workflow, or Paper
  order?
- How will the UI avoid presenting an uncertain output as a promise or
  personalized recommendation?

Live brokerage routing and real-money order paths are out of scope.

## Alternatives

Describe simpler or lower-cost alternatives considered.
